mintAuthority.summary: msY is an ERC-4626-style strategy wrapper over Main Street USD. Wrapper minting creates msY shares against deposited MSUSD, while durable base-dollar issuance is inherited from the reviewed MSUSD parent.

controls.label: msY ERC-4626-style wrapper
controls.capDescription: The wrapper mints msY shares through deposit/mint flows against MSUSD asset deposits; it does not mint base MSUSD.
controls.evidence: asset() returned 0x4ba01f22827018b4772CD326C7627FB4956A7C00, the Ethereum MSUSD parent; implementation ABI exposes deposit/mint/redeem/withdraw wrapper functions.

controls.label: msY owner Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295174: owner() returned this Safe; Safe API confirmed threshold=3, 4 owners, enabledModules=[], guard=0x0 (no guard), fallbackHandler=0xfd0732Dc9E303f09fCEf3a7388Ad10A83459Ec99, masterCopy=0x41675C099F32341bf84BFc5382aF534df5C7461a.

controls.label: Inherited MSUSD mint surface
controls.evidence: Parent MSUSD metadata already records a reviewed 2026-05-24 mintAuthority profile; msY inherits durable base issuance from that parent.

review.evidence: Local variant metadata, parent MSUSD mintAuthority, and Ethereum RPC/source reads show msY as a wrapper over MSUSD rather than a separate base stablecoin mint path. At block 25295174: Safe API confirmed guard=0x0 (no guard), enabledModules=[], threshold=3 of 4 owners. The owner Safe has parameter-only influence (deposit toggles and cooldown settings); share issuance follows only MSUSD deposits into the vault. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: local msY shares are minted only against deposited MSUSD, but repo evidence does not resolve upgradeability or every possible mint bypass; reconciliation is not applicable and no local attestor or prudential supervisor is evidenced.
